beats.event: Tess, 16, learns her family has noble d'Urberville ancestry
Falls asleep driving; wagon crash kills the family horse
Visits Mrs. d'Urberville; Alec employs her as poultry keeper
Alec rapes her at a remote spot
Bears sickly child Sorrow; christens him herself as he dies
Years later works as milkmaid at Talbothays Dairy
Grows close to apprentice farmer Angel Clare
Angel proposes; Tess reluctantly accepts
Attempts to confess her past, defers repeatedly
Wedding night: Angel confesses affair, Tess reveals hers
Angel feels betrayed, separates, leaves for Brazil
Destitute Tess labors at harsh Flintcomb-Ash farm
Alec persistently pursues her despite the marriage
Her father dies; family faces eviction
Alec offers shelter; Tess submits
Angel repents, returns, finds her as 'Mrs d'Urberville'
She tells him he has arrived too late
Tess stabs Alec to death
Five days with Angel; arrested at Stonehenge at dawn
Black flag over prison signals her execution
